title: Release portable storage from main for downstream consumers
description: Given the portable store passes required gates on develop, when the reviewed release is promoted to main and normal publishing completes, then a versioned store artifact can be installed and built by Kanbus without sibling checkouts. Verify the release tag, registry/package artifacts and consumer build; preserve existing publication gates and report credential blockers explicitly.

comments.author: home
comments.text: MAIN promotion PR34 merged at 87891d6; full CI passed. Normal release run38893764454 published nothing: PSR10 conventional parser defaults ignore_merge_commits=true, so the conventional release merge messages were ignored and source squash messages have no conventional prefix. Given a Git Flow conventional release merge, when semantic-release computes the next version, then the merge must contribute its declared bump and release artifacts must publish. Reproduced read-only with installed production PSR10. Correct parser configuration and repeat normal pipeline; no manual tag bypass.
